title: A Singular Stochastic Wave--Klein--Gordon System with Rough Gaussian Forcing and Distinct Propagation Speeds
summary: We construct spatially local paracontrolled solutions on $\mathbb{R}^3$ for the stochastic wave--Klein--Gordon system \[ (\partial_t^2-c_{\mathrm{W}}^2Δ)u=uv+ξ_{\mathrm{W}},\qquad (\partial_t^2-c_{\mathrm{K}}^2Δ+m^2)v=uv+ξ_{\mathrm{K}}, \] with $c_{\mathrm{W}}\ne c_{\mathrm{K}}$. The independent forcings are white in time and stationary in space, generated by Fourier multipliers of respective orders $β_{\mathrm{W}},β_{\mathrm{K}}$, and we assume $β_*:=\max\{β_{\mathrm{W}},β_{\mathrm{K}}\}<1/8$. The main analytic step is the construction of the mixed random operators $I_a(w\precΨ_b)\circΨ_c$.…
